diagnoses.description:
Command construction/encoding error (likely a copied or malformed “-l” flag rendered as a non-ASCII character), causing the initial directory listing step to fail.
Evidence: The command used an invalid flag: “ls: invalid option -- '�'”.
Trajectory location: turn 1

The agent did not follow the tool interface constraint requiring a single chained shell command per tool call, preventing PDF tooling checks needed to parse handbook.pdf for definitions/limits.
Evidence: Terminal tool response: “Cannot execute multiple commands at once. Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;” after the agent submitted three separate commands (python heredoc + which pdftotext + python -V).
Trajectory location: turn 3

The agent failed to continue the tool-driven workflow (did not actually run the corrected command), and terminated prematurely without performing handbook extraction, calculations, compliance checks, or writing required outputs.
Evidence: The agent emitted a message containing a JSON-like tool spec and command text as its “Final answer” (“I’ll check which PDF text-extraction tools are available locally...”), with no subsequent terminal execution and no generated files /app/output/q01.json through /app/output/q05.json.
Trajectory location: turn 4

The run never progressed beyond basic data inspection and a failed tooling check; core task requirements (handbook-driven definitions/limits and computed JSON artifacts) were not executed.
Evidence: No evidence of reading handbook.pdf, computing ramp rate/TAL/peak/speed feasibility, selecting representative thermocouple per handbook, or writing any /app/output/q0*.json files.
Trajectory location: turns 1-4
